judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A striking, well-defined mass of towering cumulus with excellent texture and contrast, though it is more a cloud study than a full sky composition.
strengths: Strong tonal contrast between sunlit tops and shadowed bases
weaknesses: Tight crop lacks scale or context
Highlights are slightly blown in places
